It is a text measurement over the tracked tree at the recorded subject; it is not Lean-compiler evidence, and it does not judge whether a proposition is worth having.
note: The two classes overlap, so they are not a partition and may not be added. Counts describe the tracked tree at `subject`; later commits do not inherit them.

rules.ALIAS_ONE_LINER: single-line theorem whose conclusion is one identifier and whose proof term is one identifier, i.e. `theorem name : contract := proof`
rules.CLOSED_NO_BINDERS: theorem that declares no binders before its conclusion colon -- no parentheses, braces or brackets -- and whose text contains no forall or lambda binder in either spelling, i.e. the statement is about concrete data
